snippet.title: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow Chapter 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
🔍✨Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992580/Ventreville_A_Cure_for_Sorrow/ ✨🔎

Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Make your choices carefully, as your decisions determine how many clues you uncover before the detective, the final player character, questions you. What clues will you choose? Will your protagonists know enough to catch the murderer?
Each chapter of this emotional story-driven game features a unique protagonist, game mechanics, story, and narrative, all tied together by the murder of Ret and Flaire Avidine.

🎙️Partial Voice Acting: Each character brought to life with their own voice actor!
💖 Befriend the Victims: Get to know Ret and Flaire Avidine before their untimely demise.
🦋 Butterfly Effect: Your decisions determine what clues the detective has available in the final chapter
🔚 Choices with Consequences: Replay the multiple routes, and get all the endings!
📗 Multiple Stories: Explore the city! Three full side-stories that progress each time you return to them.
💬 More than 75k words for 2.5 hours of gameplay per playthrough per chapter.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
